'''2010 Malastare Regionals Michael Bragg DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Bragg]] at [[2010 Malastare Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Droid-vasion
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
